name: chpu
description:
The phrase as a ЧПУ (a human-readable URL part): latin letters and digits in lower case, cyrillic in translit, accented letters as plain ones; the spaces and signs between words become one «-», none at the edges: «Диван-кровать 2 м!» → «divan-krovat-2-m», «Щётка  ёж» → «schetka-ezh».

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv chpu write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
